## Context
The exhaustive current-main macOS census found remaining multi-second costs caused by test-scale wall-clock windows rather than useful production work: review-bot ticket bootstrap is about 10.15 worker-phase seconds per cell, lock-retry coverage totals about 15.56s per cell, review-bot shutdown cases are about 9s per cell, and autodeploy coverage includes an explicit 3s sleep plus an 8.25s unreachable-health case. Production timeout, retry, drain, and health budgets are contractual and must remain unchanged.

Closed classless-dainty-lamprey already proved and landed the same pattern for snapshot low-speed and retry tests. Maintained OSS consensus supports the direction: CPython uses 0.05-0.1s trigger windows with generous cleanup deadlines, and urllib3 injects or scales backoff while retaining real sockets. Ticket history requires retaining real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health behavior: royal-weariless-zebrafish, odorful-epidemic-shelduck, balsamy-eloquent-iggypops, equestrian-clueless-cowbird, and unskillful-supportive-lion.

## Plan
- Reprofile each named family alone on current main and record wall and worker-phase baselines.
- Freeze behavioral contract cards for attempt counts, logical backoff schedules, real lock/process/socket behavior, terminal states, cleanup, and exact error/observability output.
- Inject or scale only test-owned clocks/windows; retain real boundary execution and generous teardown polling.
- Prove each final oracle RED against an exact-defect mutation before implementation, then GREEN.
- Run focused suites, lint, typecheck, and full Gerrit Verify; report per-cell and aggregate runner savings and the first post-merge organic observation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Production timeout, retry, drain, health, and backoff defaults are byte-for-byte unchanged.
- [x] Real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary coverage remains enabled.
- [x] Each shortened case preserves attempt counts, logical schedule, terminal state, cleanup, and observability assertions.
- [x] Each case has legitimate RED-to-GREEN and exact-defect mutation evidence.
- [x] Same-host before/after timings report macOS wall and total runner savings.
- [x] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and merge are recorded before closure.
